response.sql: WITH media_type_stats AS (SELECT mt.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) as track_count, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS DECIMAL(30,10)) / CAST(SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS DECIMAL(30,10)) as bytes_per_ms FROM MediaType mt INNER JOIN Track t ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name), average_rate AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) as avg_rate FROM media_type_stats) SELECT mts.Name, mts.bytes_per_ms as rate, mts.track_count, mts.bytes_per_ms - ar.avg_rate as above_average FROM media_type_stats mts CROSS JOIN average_rate ar WHERE mts.bytes_per_ms > ar.avg_rate;
